prerequisite.requirement: successful complete finite n=32 full-model KLD analysis; no KLD threshold is imposed before the speed measurement

question: Is uniform all-layer native P8 faster than the exact local EXL3 K4 checkpoint/runtime in a matched target-only TP4 serving regime?

candidate.name: p8
candidate.mma: mxf8f6f4 m16n8k32; twice NVFP4 MMA issues per equal logical K

common_serving_regime.purpose: target-weight codec comparison, not speculative-decoder product throughput
common_serving_regime.topology: TP4, expert parallelism off, DCP1, one sequence
common_serving_regime.cuda_graphs: enabled in both arms; engine config and completed graph capture required in logs
common_serving_regime.power_and_clocks: do not mutate; record every run and require the same four physical GPUs

benchmark.prefill_metric: auto; client headline plus uncontaminated Prometheus validation
benchmark.primary_prefill: 32K Prometheus-validated server input tokens/s; client tokens/s also reported
benchmark.primary_decode: C1 32K aggregate output tokens/s from OpenAI continuous usage
benchmark.secondary_cells: 64K prefill and C1 64K decode; report but do not redefine the gate

decision_before_result.pass: median of five P8 cold runs must be strictly greater than median of five EXL3 cold runs for both primary 32K prefill and primary C1 32K decode
decision_before_result.fail: a tie, regression, non-finite value, missing backend/graph evidence, fewer than five valid cold runs per arm, or topology/request mismatch stops the native6 Shapley allocation game
decision_before_result.secondary: report every run and both 64K cells without changing the primary decision
decision_before_result.claim_boundary: the images differ because each codec requires its exact local runtime; this is an end-product serving comparison, not a causal kernel-only attribution

operational_policy.failures: preserve every failed attempt; an operational retry retains the same round and arm identity and is never substituted silently
operational_policy.cold_definition: new server container and worker processes for every arm/run; compiled caches remain warm and are outside the cold definition, while image, source, tool, and exact cache paths are recorded
operational_policy.service_restore: preserve and restore prior production timer/backend state
